caption:
McDonald's ka scale sirf ek revenue number se samajh nahi aata. 🍔

2025 ke end par 45,356 restaurants aur 100+ countries mein presence thi. Us saal McDonald's Corporation ka consolidated revenue $26.9B tha; systemwide restaurant sales $139.4B thi. Dono alag measures hain, kyunki franchise restaurants ki customer sales poori company revenue mein count nahi hoti.

Euromonitor ke mutabik 2025 global consumer foodservice market $3.36T tha. Yeh broad industry hai—McDonald's ka direct market share nikalne ke liye is number ko company revenue se divide nahi karna chahiye.

Sources (2025 data): McDonald's Annual Report: https://corporate.mcdonalds.com/content/dam/sites/corp/nfl/pdf/MCD%202025%20Annual%20Report.pdf ; Euromonitor: https://www.euromonitor.com/newsroom/press-releases/april-2026/one-in-five-dollars-spent-on-global-foodservice-delivery-in-2025
